CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content present.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates), organization (grouped coordinates) and a distinct origin/status entry are all explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition linked to the same content's presentation or access is stated.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit identifications of content (color attributes bound to coordinate sets) are provided.

D.rationale: Origins/status metadata are explicitly attached to identified contents, distinguishing content identity from provenance/status.

O.rationale: The report states how content is organized/presented (grid orientation, grouped coordinate sets and candidate peaks).
